2026-08-19T02:37:19.5790943Z   PR_TITLE: Add CLAUDE.md §24: Cloudflare Workers access via FUNTOKEN_IO_CF / FT_GAMES_CF
2026-08-19T02:37:19.5820689Z   PR_BODY: ## Summary

The session environment now carries two new Cloudflare credential env vars, each a single `<account_id>:<api_token>` string:

| Env var | Covers |
|---|---|
| `FUNTOKEN_IO_CF` | funtoken.io |
| `FT_GAMES_CF` | ft.games, 5m.fun |

This PR documents them as a new **CLAUDE.md §24 — Cloudflare Access (MANDATORY)**, giving them the same standing-policy treatment §22 gives `DIGITALOCEAN_ACCESS_TOKEN` and §23 gives `GH_TOKEN`. Consumer repos receive §24 automatically through the existing root `CLAUDE.md` mirror in `update_workflows.yml` (`workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md` is a symlink to the root file) on the next `@stable` sync — no downstream edits are needed.

## What §24 says

- **§24.A** — site-to-credential map (the two vars are **different Cloudflare accounts**, not interchangeable), first-colon split into `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID` / `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`, wrangler/REST transport, and a health-check gotcha found during live verification: these account-owned tokens return 401 `Invalid API Token` on `GET /user/tokens/verify` even when valid — the canonical probe is the account-scoped `workers/scripts` list.
- **§24.B** — read operations are self-serve (Worker scripts, bindings, routes, deployments, DNS on covered zones, `wrangler tail`), an explicit carve-out from §2.
- **§24.C** — creating/editing/deploying Workers is self-serve when the task calls for it — that is what the credentials exist for — with only-covered-domains, validate-before-deploy, and preserve-rollback constraints.
